Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a cap on credit card transaction fees paid by small business owners.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assisting small business owners by capping thecredit card transaction fee paid by such owners; and adding a newchapter to Title 19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A fee charged by a financial institutionfor the processing of a credit card transaction to a small businessowner must be set at a percentage rate of no higher than the rateestablished in subsection (2) of this section. (2) By no later than January 2, 2009, the department of financialinstitutions must negotiate, on behalf of small business ownerslicensed within Washington state, a written agreement limiting themaximum transaction fee that financial institutions doing business withsmall business owners licensed in this state may charge such businessowners for the processing of a credit card transaction. (a) The agreement must include a maximum percentage rate, asprovided in (b) of this subsection (2), that financial institutions maycharge small business owners licensed in the state of Washington. (b) The department of financial institutions must negotiate amaximum percentage rate that is no higher than the maximum percentage p. 1 SB 6825rate that is allowed to be charged to state agencies by financialinstitutions for the processing of similar credit card transactions.For the purposes of this subsection (2)(b), the department of generaladministration must notify the department of financial institutions ofthe maximum percentage rate that financial institutions are allowed tocharge state agencies as of the effective date of this act, andannually every year thereafter. (c) The percentage rate established by agreement under this sectionmust be adjusted annually to reflect any changes in the credit cardtransaction fee percentage rate charged to state agencies, as reportedto the department of financial institutions by the department ofgeneral administration under subsection (2)(b) of this section.

The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Small business owner" has the same meaning as provided in RCW19.85.020. (2) "Financial institution" has the same meaning as provided in RCW31.45.010.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 19 RCW.
